questiontext.text:
The graph shows a demand curve and a supply curve for a competitive market. Drag the orange point to the competitive equilibrium.

[[jsxgraph width="560px" height="460px" input-ref-xclick="xRef" input-ref-yclick="yRef"]] var a={#a#}, b={#b#}, c={#c#}, d={#d#}; var pStar={#pStar#}, qStar={#qStar#}; var xMax=Math.ceil(qStar*2.2/10)*10; var yMax=Math.ceil(Math.max(pStar*2.2, a/b)/10)*10; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [0, yMax, xMax, 0], axis: true, grid: true, zoom: {enabled:false}, pan: {enabled:false}, showNavigation: false, defaultAxes: { x: {name:'Q', withLabel:true, label:{position:'rt', offset:[0,-15]}}, y: {name:'P', withLabel:true, label:{position:'rt', offset:[15,0]}} } }); board.create('functiongraph', [function(q){return (a-q)/b;}, 0, xMax], {strokeColor:'black', strokeWidth:2, name:'Demand', withLabel:true, label:{position:'lft', offset:[10,10]}}); board.create('functiongraph', [function(q){return (q+c)/d;}, 0, xMax], {strokeColor:'black', strokeWidth:2, name:'Supply', withLabel:true, label:{position:'lft', offset:[10,-15]}}); var pt = board.create('point', [qStar*0.35, pStar*1.7], { color:'orange', size:6, name:'Your answer', label:{visible:false}, snapToGrid:false }); function updateInputs() { document.getElementById(xRef).value = pt.X().toFixed(4); document.getElementById(yRef).value = pt.Y().toFixed(4); } pt.on('drag', updateInputs); pt.on('up', updateInputs); updateInputs(); [[/jsxgraph]]

questionnote.text: a={#a#}, b={#b#}, c={#c#}, d={#d#} → Q*={#round(qStar,2)#}, P*={#round(pStar,2)#}

feedbackvariables.text: qCorrect: abs(xclick - qStar) < 4; pCorrect: abs(yclick - pStar) < 4;

questiontext.text:
The graph shows demand, the original supply, and the supply curve after a per-unit tax of \(t = {#t#}\) is imposed on suppliers. Drag the orange point to the new market equilibrium.

[[jsxgraph width="560px" height="460px" input-ref-xclick="xRef" input-ref-yclick="yRef"]] var a={#a#}, b={#b#}, c={#c#}, d={#d#}, t={#t#}; var qOrig={#qOrig#}, pOrig={#pOrig#}; var qStar={#qStar#}, pStar={#pStar#}; var xMax=Math.ceil(Math.max(qOrig,qStar)*2.3/10)*10; var yMax=Math.ceil(Math.max(pStar*2.3, a/b)/10)*10; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [0, yMax, xMax, 0], axis: true, grid: true, zoom: {enabled:false}, pan: {enabled:false}, showNavigation: false, defaultAxes: { x: {name:'Q', withLabel:true, label:{position:'rt', offset:[0,-15]}}, y: {name:'P', withLabel:true, label:{position:'rt', offset:[15,0]}} } }); board.create('functiongraph', [function(q){return (a-q)/b;}, 0, xMax], {strokeColor:'black', strokeWidth:2, name:'Demand', withLabel:true, label:{position:'lft', offset:[10,10]}}); board.create('functiongraph', [function(q){return (q+c)/d;}, 0, xMax], {strokeColor:'black', strokeWidth:2, dash:2, name:'Supply (original)', withLabel:true, label:{position:'lft', offset:[10,-10]}}); board.create('functiongraph', [function(q){return (q+c)/d + t;}, 0, xMax], {strokeColor:'black', strokeWidth:2, name:'Supply (after tax)', withLabel:true, label:{position:'lft', offset:[10,-25]}}); var pt = board.create('point', [qStar*0.35, pStar*1.7], { color:'orange', size:6, name:'Your answer', label:{visible:false}, snapToGrid:false }); function updateInputs() { document.getElementById(xRef).value = pt.X().toFixed(4); document.getElementById(yRef).value = pt.Y().toFixed(4); } pt.on('drag', updateInputs); pt.on('up', updateInputs); updateInputs(); [[/jsxgraph]]

questiontext.text:
The graph shows three indifference curves (\(U = x \cdot y\)) and a budget line (\(P_x = {#px#}\), \(P_y = {#py#}\), \(I = {#I#}\)). Drag the orange point to the constrained utility-maximizing bundle.

[[jsxgraph width="560px" height="460px" input-ref-xclick="xRef" input-ref-yclick="yRef"]] var px={#px#}, py={#py#}, Inco={#I#}; var xStar={#xStar#}, yStar={#yStar#}; var uStar={#uStar#}; var uLow=uStar*0.45, uHigh=uStar*1.65; var xBudget=Inco/px, yBudget=Inco/py; var xMax=xBudget*1.3, yMax=yBudget*1.3; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [0, yMax, xMax, 0], axis: true, grid: true, zoom: {enabled:false}, pan: {enabled:false}, showNavigation: false, defaultAxes: { x: {name:'x', withLabel:true, label:{position:'rt', offset:[0,-15]}}, y: {name:'y', withLabel:true, label:{position:'rt', offset:[15,0]}} } }); // Indifference curves y = U / x board.create('functiongraph', [function(x){return uLow/x;}, 0.3, xMax], {strokeColor:'black', strokeWidth:2, name:'IC\u2081', withLabel:true, label:{position:'lft', offset:[5,10]}}); board.create('functiongraph', [function(x){return uStar/x;}, 0.3, xMax], {strokeColor:'black', strokeWidth:2, name:'IC\u2082', withLabel:true, label:{position:'lft', offset:[5,10]}}); board.create('functiongraph', [function(x){return uHigh/x;}, 0.3, xMax], {strokeColor:'black', strokeWidth:2, name:'IC\u2083', withLabel:true, label:{position:'lft', offset:[5,10]}}); // Budget line y = (I - px*x) / py board.create('functiongraph', [function(x){return (Inco - px*x)/py;}, 0, xBudget], {strokeColor:'black', strokeWidth:2, dash:2, name:'Budget', withLabel:true, label:{position:'lft', offset:[5,-15]}}); var pt = board.create('point', [xStar*0.3, yStar*1.8], { color:'orange', size:6, name:'Your answer', label:{visible:false}, snapToGrid:false }); function updateInputs() { document.getElementById(xRef).value = pt.X().toFixed(4); document.getElementById(yRef).value = pt.Y().toFixed(4); } pt.on('drag', updateInputs); pt.on('up', updateInputs); updateInputs(); [[/jsxgraph]]

questiontext.text:
The graph shows demand, private marginal cost (PMC), and social marginal cost (SMC) for a market with a negative production externality. Drag the orange point to the socially efficient equilibrium.

[[jsxgraph width="560px" height="460px" input-ref-xclick="xRef" input-ref-yclick="yRef"]] var a={#a#}, b={#b#}, c={#c#}, d={#d#}, e={#e#}; var qStar={#qStar#}, pStar={#pStar#}; var qMarket={#qMarket#}; var xMax=Math.ceil(qMarket*2.2/10)*10; var yMax=Math.ceil(Math.max(pStar*2.2, a*0.9)/10)*10; var board = JXG.JSXGraph.initBoard(divid, { boundingbox: [0, yMax, xMax, 0], axis: true, grid: true, zoom: {enabled:false}, pan: {enabled:false}, showNavigation: false, defaultAxes: { x: {name:'Q', withLabel:true, label:{position:'rt', offset:[0,-15]}}, y: {name:'P', withLabel:true, label:{position:'rt', offset:[15,0]}} } }); board.create('functiongraph', [function(q){return a - b*q;}, 0, xMax], {strokeColor:'black', strokeWidth:2, name:'Demand', withLabel:true, label:{position:'lft', offset:[5,10]}}); board.create('functiongraph', [function(q){return c + d*q;}, 0, xMax], {strokeColor:'black', strokeWidth:2, name:'PMC', withLabel:true, label:{position:'lft', offset:[5,-10]}}); board.create('functiongraph', [function(q){return c + (d+e)*q;}, 0, xMax], {strokeColor:'black', strokeWidth:2, dash:2, name:'SMC', withLabel:true, label:{position:'lft', offset:[5,-25]}}); var pt = board.create('point', [qStar*0.35, pStar*1.7], { color:'orange', size:6, name:'Your answer', label:{visible:false}, snapToGrid:false }); function updateInputs() { document.getElementById(xRef).value = pt.X().toFixed(4); document.getElementById(yRef).value = pt.Y().toFixed(4); } pt.on('drag', updateInputs); pt.on('up', updateInputs); updateInputs(); [[/jsxgraph]]
